messages.text:
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Thanks Darrell.

To validate the claim on the NerdOctaxe I need one thing first: what exactly is it doing? For example no power at all, fans spin but no hashrate, screen blank, restarts, or an error on the display.

Start me with that one line and we'll work through it a check at a time.
I'm looking that code up rather than guessing. One moment.
Searched the web · NerdOctaxe "VREG OVERHEATED" Guru Meditation ESP32
Searched the web · "Guru Meditation" "45080000" NerdOctaxe VREG

Thanks, that's a useful code.

What it means: that message is the voltage regulator temperature trip. The firmware reads the VR temp sensor the instant it enables the ASIC voltage, sees a trip value, and cuts the core voltage back to 0V, so the chips never start. It's documented in the ESP-Miner issue tracker for the NerdQAxe/Octaxe family (shufps/ESP-Miner-NerdQAxePlus issue #····), where the board showed the same "VREG Overheated Guru Meditation" with voltage dropping about 20ms after enable.

Two things decide whether this is a real cooked regulator or a sensor/firmware read, and I need the first one:

1. What firmware version is the unit on? It's on the web UI home page, or cycle the OLED screens.

Also tell me, in one line: did it ever hash normally, and for how long, or has it done this since the first plug-in?

No problem, take your time.

When you're back at the unit, send me those two things:

1. The firmware version (web UI home page, or cycle through the OLED screens).
2. Whether it ever hashed normally, and for how long, or if it has done this since day one.

With those I can tell you whether this is a firmware-side read or the regulator itself, and I'll carry on from there.

Firmware has been updated to latest and it has worked great then in June I got the same code and updated the firmware and it worked up until October 30th and no matter what firmware I changed to even going back to the old firmware it still showed about 15 sec after restarting
*(Chat handed back to Sarah with the technical verdict recorded; no reply sent.)*
